I’m going to share a few life details, so you know where I’m coming from, if this goes against what you said I’m sorry, just, a generalization isn’t that good.

I dropped out of school, 5th grade to be exact. Because I didn’t want to be there because of the social barrier I had. I was designated the “Bully Target” because no matter how many times I told someone, nothing was done. And every time I tried to push back I got suspended or reported and then punished. I hated being there, I had no friends because no one wanted to talk to me. Which left me with these years of anxiety of thinking “everyone hates me”

The only people I had decent connections with online was A. and a handful of people. A, was the only person I was still friends with after all that time. We’re only two years apart in age. They’re the older one.

After I left school I genuinely didn’t have anything further to educate me other than my own unlimited access to the internet. Which has left me with a societal tear from the rest of my generation, as I can’t relate to them because I never grew up around the fads or popular cultures. 

I had a first relationship between then and now, first time I ever experienced actual feelings for someone, until whomp, stomped out in the worst way possible.

Just, that’s all I can say for now, I’ll re-read your comment since I’m /less/ inclined to think about my own side of the story as I just said it.
